support.application: per scenario and temporal block on train
support.unit: distinct train participants with original feature observed

numeric.scaling: StandardScaler fit on train after imputation
numeric.missing_indicator: one indicator for every retained numeric feature; train-zero constants removed later

binary.missing_indicator: one indicator for every retained binary feature; train-zero constants removed later

multi_response.validation_unknown: ignored after audit; __UNKNOWN__ train-constant column removed by zero-variance filter

temporal_source_exclusions.rule: BENCHMARK05B flags collected on or after current target MRI are set missing
temporal_source_exclusions.application_order: before modality presence, semantic transform, imputation and encoding

modality.indicator: one modality_present indicator per source-backed block; no presence indicator for derived covariates
modality.computed: after temporal source exclusions and before support imputation

variance_filter.rule: remove non-finite or zero-range encoded columns using train only

test.policy: same frozen state will be applied only after final model lock
